purpose: Pre-flight regression check on the NEW graham-z41 tool copies (generate_witnesses.cpp, verify_witnesses.go, verify_orbit_accounting.py) before trusting them for the real, novel Z_41 sizes 34-40 run. Confirms the copy-and-retarget (comment/default changes only, no logic changes) did not introduce a transcription error, by reproducing the already-committed, previously-verified Z_29 sizes 21-28 certificate byte-for-byte.
method: Compiled a second generator binary from the SAME erdosfire/oracle/tools/frontier-math/round4/graham-z41/generate_witnesses.cpp source with -DPRIME=29 (CLI args 21 28 for the size range), ran it fresh into a scratch path (not erdosfire/evidence/round4-discovery/graham-z29/, which was never touched), then ran the new graham-z41 copies of both verifiers against that fresh output with --prime 29 --min-k 21 --max-k 28.
conclusion: New graham-z41 tool copies (generator + both verifiers) reproduce the known-good Z_29 sizes 21-28 certificate byte-for-byte and both verifiers independently confirm it. No transcription drift from the graham-z37 originals. Proceeding to the real Z_41 sizes 34-40 run with confidence in the tooling itself (does not and cannot validate the Z_41 mathematical result, which is genuinely new).
